Linear-pool envelope diagnostic (Stage-0 SS9.2)

Source: R/diagnostics.R
linear_pool_envelope.Rd

An equal-weight mixture of the contributing lenses' conditional-mean predictives, deliberately over-dispersed to serve as a reference bracket rather than a confident prediction. For each observation the envelope half-width combines the average within-lens posterior uncertainty with the between-lens disagreement, the latter inflated by inflate (default 2). The reported envelope is the full equal-weight pool; flagging is leave-one-out — a lens is flagged at an observation when its posterior-mean response falls outside the over-dispersed bracket formed by the other lenses, so a disagreement carrier is caught against the consensus rather than inflating its own bracket. The envelope is a diagnostic surface only and is never shipped as the opinion (I2).

Usage

linear_pool_envelope(fb_fits, pass, inflate = 2, level = 0.95)

Arguments

fb_fits

A list of contributed koine_fb_fit objects (opinion lenses).

pass

The originating koine_pass.

inflate

Over-dispersion multiplier on the between-lens disagreement variance (default 2, per SS9.2's "inflated approximately 2x disagreement").

level

Central interval width for the bracket (default 0.95).

Value

A list with obs_id, pool_mean, lower, upper (length-N vectors), flags (a data frame of lens_id x out-of-envelope counts), n_components, and inflate; or NULL when fewer than two lenses expose a comparable mean-response (no envelope is meaningful).

Details

Operates on the conditional-mean scale mu_i = linkinv(eta_i), which is comparable across every lens regardless of likelihood-tail differences, so a robust-t lens and a Gaussian lens are bracketed on the same footing.

Examples

# \donttest{
set.seed(1)
d <- data.frame(y = 1 + rnorm(50), x = rnorm(50))
pass <- koine_pass(y ~ x, d, gaussian())
fits <- list(
  fit_dram(pass, n_iter = 800L, n_burn = 400L, n_chains = 2L),
  fit_robust_t(pass, n_iter = 800L, n_burn = 400L, n_chains = 2L))
env <- linear_pool_envelope(fits, pass)
env$flags
#>    lens_id n_outside n_obs
#> 1     dram         0    50
#> 2 robust_t         0    50
# }
